gaps.quote: The outer two cost linear time.
gaps.note: The page never says why D<-D-H and D<-H-D are linear time. The paper (lines 1433-1435, Lemma matrix-shear/Prop. power-interchange) gives the reason: these updates target the later group, controlled by the earlier one, so they can be done in one ordered pass. The page omits the hypothesis that H precedes D on the tape; without it the claim is unsupported.

gaps.term: width mu^d and mu x mu matrices
gaps.quote: Let $F_d$ be the time per unit volume of a width-$\mu^d$ interchange
gaps.note: The page never says how a mu x mu vertex matrix relates to width mu^d: each chunk is split into mu consecutive fields of width mu^(d-1), the matrix acts on these mu fields, and the pivot pairs of those fields are the smaller interchanges (paper lines 1498-1500, 1527-1531). Without this the claim that the smaller calls have width mu^(d-1) cannot be checked.

gaps.quote: If $\lambda\le1$ the sum is at most $d$.
gaps.note: The sum 1+lambda+...+lambda^d has d+1 terms, so for lambda<=1 it is at most d+1, not d (for d=0 it equals 1). The paper says at most k+1 (line 1556).
The page never gives the value of mu for the explicit network; the bound mu<2^20 comes from m=h^3=10^6 in the paper (line 1332 uses m<2^20, definition at line 654). The reader cannot check it.
The hypothesis mu>=2 (paper: m,W>=2, line 1448) is never stated on the page, yet it is needed to absorb the d+1 and lambda^d terms into mu^(d tau).

gaps.quote: The shear is such an invocation, with $D$ as $X$ and $H$ as $Y$, so it is exact for any initial auxiliary contents.
gaps.note: Inconsistent with the paper and with the page's own description. In the paper X and Y are banks of bit values on wires, and the forward invocation adds x_S to y_S pointwise over F_2 (Lemma scalar-motifs, lines 729-731). The address shear H<-H+D over Z/qZ is not that invocation: it is produced by applying the frame permutations Phi_{A_e} to each role stream and the endpoint identity M_out(rho(w)) - M_in(w) = I (lines 1534-1545), with scratch roles handled because their initial values are arbitrary. D and H are address fields, not the banks X and Y. The page's identification is wrong and gives no argument.

gaps.quote: which for width $u=\mu^d$ is $O(u^{\tau})$ per unit volume
gaps.note: The opening claims O(Vu^tau) for fields of u bits for any u, but the derivation covers only widths mu^d, and the paper also needs the row field length divisible by W^k (Proposition power-interchange, lines 1481-1485). Arbitrary u needs the base-mu decomposition, padding of rows, and conversion of binary fields to radix-q digits of Lemma chunk-swap (lines 1631-1735), none of which the page gives.
